answer_1.quote: We use the detoxified LMs to generate completions of WAE or AAE prompts. We ask crowdworkers to compare the generations to those from a baseline GPT-2 model.
answer_1.outputs: Generated continuations (30 tokens) conditioned on WAE or AAE prompts

answer_4.quote: Each example is evaluated by three different crowdworkers. Annotators are shown the prompt and asked to select the better of two model-generated continuations based on toxicity and three measures of generation quality: topicality, fluency, and style.
answer_4.guideline: Crowdworkers compare two continuations and judge which is better according to toxicity, topicality, fluency, and style.
